topics.name: Bootstrap Cache
topics.purpose: Define optional immutable cache of validated bootstrap parsing keyed by exact content/profile.

semantics.key_rule: Cache key includes exact bootstrap content hash and parser/profile version.
semantics.content_rule: Cached value is parsed/validated bootstrap context only.
semantics.invalidation_rule: Any key input change invalidates reuse.
semantics.failure_rule: Cache corruption triggers reparse/fail, never trust-by-cache.
semantics.serialization_rule: Cached representation is not canonical source.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.
